subject: BioLume AWS co-sell intro & onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BioLume AWS co-sell intro & onboarding checklist

Team —

Quick sync request: AWS rep Renee Cho (cc'ing below once we loop AWS in) has signaled interest in a co-sell engagement with BioLume, a mid-market medtech that wants to list on the AWS Marketplace and run inference workloads in us-west-2. Karthik, can you lead the customer intro and own the initial discovery? High-level asks from Renee: a short technical overview, procurement readiness (billing/po requirements), and a mutual action plan (MAP) so AWS can qualify for their co-sell funnel.

I attached a MAP template (BioLume_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short onboarding checklist in Drive; goal is to get a 30-min intro call scheduled this week. Proposed slots (PST): Mon 6/21 10:00 or Tue 6/22 14:00 — please flag availability.

Kimberly — please be ready to produce the SOC2 summary and any initial security artifacts; BioLume will likely ask for it during the intro. Laura — can you coordinate the AWS contact mapping (Renee + field solutions lead) and confirm whether we should request an accelerated listing intake?

Next steps:
- Karthik: draft intro to BioLume and AWS (request meeting + attach MAP)
- Kimberly: attach SOC2_summary.pdf and note any outstanding evidence items
- Laura: confirm AWS contact list and co-sell eligibility docs

Thanks — trying to keep momentum so AWS can route co-sell opportunity into their rep funnel.

— Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Eli Sanders <eli.sanders@biolume.com>
Cc: Renee Cho <renee.cho@amazon.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Subject: Intro + 30-min sync to discuss AWS marketplace listing & Redwood integration

Hi Eli — great speaking with you at HealthTech West. Per our conversation, I wanted to introduce you to Renee from the AWS marketplace team and loop in Sofia who will help coordinate the joint plan. We recommend a short 30-min intro to align on listing timeline, procurement cadence, and a mutual action plan (attached). Proposed times (PST): Mon 6/21 10:00 or Tue 6/22 14:00.

Attachments: BioLume_MAP_v1.xlsx

Agenda (30 min):
- 5m intros and goals
- 10m listing & procurement questions
- 10m technical scope & demo ask
- 5m next steps / MAP assignments

If one of those times works I will calendar invite and include a short security summary from Redwood.

Best,
Karthik
--- end draft ---

Kimberly: I attached the SOC2 summary to this thread; I also noted two items that may need deeper evidence (encryption key custody + retention policy). If BioLume requests an NDA before sharing sensitive IP, I have a doc ready for signature (will attach before sending externally).

I'll hold sending until Laura confirms Renee's address.

— Karthik

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Eli Sanders <eli.sanders@biolume.com>
Cc: Renee Cho <renee.cho@amazon.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + 30-min sync to discuss AWS marketplace listing & Redwood integration

Hi Eli —

Following up from our intro at HealthTech West — pleased to connect you with Renee from the AWS Marketplace team (cc'd). Renee, BioLume is evaluating a listing and co-sell path for their inference workloads; they are targeting us-west-2 and expect to start a pilot in Q3.

Proposed 30-min times (PST): Mon 6/21 10:00 or Tue 6/22 14:00. Agenda is short (see attached MAP).

Attachments: BioLume_MAP_v1.xlsx

Renee — quick note on procurement: BioLume expects to use PO-based billing and will need an expected invoice cadence. Can AWS confirm typical timelines for listing intake and whether pace incentives apply?

Eli — if you prefer a different time, share options and we'll adapt.

Thanks all,
Karthik
